root_cause: The canonical Portal V2 cockpit showed an unbounded priority list; its metric formatter and scenario engine converted missing numeric evidence to zero, concealing unknown customer financial data.
prevention: Reuse canonical Portal V2, decision runtime and simulation engine instead of introducing parallel stores.
Bound the executive first screen to the top three ranked decisions without discarding additional candidates.
Preserve unknown/null/blank metrics and confidence instead of synthesizing a zero.
Enforce regression tests and protected release evidence before claiming live production.

success_criteria: Three top decisions are visible and the other decisions stay accessible.
Null/blank scenario baselines do not produce false zero-value outcomes.
Protected Required and CodeQL pass at exact HEAD, followed by merge and production readback.
